title: Release Spend Request: declare indirect modify permission on Spend Request
summary: Release Spend Request codeunit now declares indirect modify permission on Spend Request, allowing the Expense Agent to submit and reject travel requests through proper permission inheritance.
key_points: Added permission declaration for indirect modify on Spend Request table to codeunit 6840
Enables Expense Agent (S2S) to perform writes through the codeunit when direct permission is not granted
Added two new tests verifying submit and reject operations work with restricted permission set
Follows same pattern used by Release Sales Document and Release Purchase Document
